Attend a Pre-Conference Workshop at SEM
Expand your expertise before the conference begins with AACRAO SEM pre-conference workshops. These interactive sessions provide focused, practical learning on key enrollment management topics.
Registration for the full SEM Conference is not required
. You may register for one or more pre-conference workshops as standalone professional development opportunities.
